description:
The GoDaddy Business Email Management API provides capabilities for listing
and provisioning mailboxes for domains owned by the authenticated
account.

## Namespace

All paths are under `/v1/email/`. The namespace is `email` (the business
capability); the core entity collection is `/mailboxes`.

## Key Conventions

**Asynchronous creation.** `POST /mailboxes` returns `202 Accepted` with the
mailbox in its initial state (status: EXECUTING). Poll `GET /mailboxes/{mailboxId}`
until status reaches COMPLETED or FAILED.

Determines whether a mailbox can be provisioned for the given
email address and which entitlements are available to use.

account. Returns 202 Accepted with the mailbox in its initial state
(status: EXECUTING). Poll GET /mailboxes/{mailboxId} until status
reaches COMPLETED or FAILED.
